jobs.occupation: Data Engineer - Azure based data platform
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Data Engineer to support the development and maintenance of an Azure-based data platform, ensuring data is accessible, high-quality, and fit for purpose.

This is a hands-on, execution-focused data engineering role, where you will work primarily on SQL transformations, data pipelines, and platform optimisation. You will contribute to building robust and scalable data solutions that enable analytics and reporting across the organisation.

Key responsibilities

• You build, monitor and optimize data pipelines using Azure Synapse and Data Factory
• You design and optimize data storage solutions (Azure Data Lake, Synapse Analytics)
• You develop and maintain scalable SQL transformations
• You ensure data quality, reliability, and performance across the platfform
• You collaborate with analysts and business teams to deliver reliable and usable datasets
• You support data governance, security, and compliance requirements

Your Profile

• You bring solid experience in data engineering (min. 5 years), preferably within an Azure-based environment
• You have completed a master’s degree in Data, IT, or Economics, or you possess an equivalent level of analytical and practical skills based on your experience.
• You have strong SQL skills and experience with modern data platforms and transformation processes
• You communicate fluently in English, knowledge of Dutch is a plus.

Responsibilities

• Analyze and document AS-IS and TO-BE business processes to identify improvement opportunities.
• Translate complex business requirements into clear functional specifications and project documentation.
• Collaborate with stakeholders and technical teams to design and implement robust IT solutions.
• Perform data analysis to support business decisions and continuous improvement initiatives.
• Support testing, validation, and deployment activities while ensuring compliance with regulatory standards.
• Coordinate project delivery activities and provide knowledge transfer to end users during implementation.

Requirements

• You possess 3+ years of experience as an IT Business Analyst.
• You have proven experience working within Agile delivery environments.
• You bring a strong background in reporting and data analysis including work with databases.
• You have solid experience in project coordination and supporting complex business transformations.
• You are proficient with Microsoft Office tools.
• You have proven stakeholder management and relationship-building capabilities.
• You're proactive and solution-oriented with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
• You are fluent in English and either French or Dutch.
Nice to Haves

• Knowledge of SAP.
• Experience with BPMN modelling and Sparx Enterprise Architect.
• Background in the energy, utilities, finance, or other regulated industries.
• Understanding of budgeting, forecasting, and financial processes.
• Trilingual proficiency in English, French, and Dutch.

Currently in a phase of significant growth, they are looking for motivated and dedicated team members to join their mission.

Are you a (recent) graduate with a bachelor’s degree in biotechnology, chemistry, agro- or life sciences? Are you ready to put your knowledge and skills into practice in a setting where innovation meets purpose?
